findings: F-WP-1 (actor from body, spoofable): src/modules/project-registry/presentation/projects.controller.ts:263 — POST /projects/:id/assign-team sources actorId from the request BODY (request.actorId, defined as a required field in assign-project-team.request.ts:20) instead of the authenticated principal. Every other lifecycle handler in this controller (submit/approve/reject/close at lines 127,149,170,192,221) reads httpRequest.principal?.personId. A caller can attribute a team assignment to any arbitrary personId.

F-WP-2 (no class-validator DTO — bare TS class): src/modules/project-registry/presentation/projects.controller.ts:60-66 — UpdateProjectRequestDto is a plain class with ZERO validation decorators. Because the global ValidationPipe runs whitelist:true (src/main.ts:68-71), an undecorated class has no whitelisted properties, so name/description/status/projectManagerId/deliveryManagerId are all STRIPPED before reaching the handler — PATCH /projects/:id silently persists nothing (update-project.service.ts receives all-undefined fields → enrich() is a no-op, manager-reassign branch never runs). Functional no-op bug similar in effect to F-WP-3.

F-WP-2 (no class-validator DTO — bare interfaces): src/modules/project-registry/presentation/vendor.controller.ts binds @Body() to CreateVendorDto/UpdateVendorDto/CreateVendorEngagementDto which are TypeScript *interfaces* (vendor.service.ts:17,26,51) and Partial<CreateVendorEngagementDto> (vendor.controller.ts:80). Interfaces erase to no runtime metatype, so the global ValidationPipe skips validation entirely — POST/PATCH /vendors, POST /projects/:id/vendors, PATCH /projects/:projectId/vendors/:engagementId accept unvalidated bodies (e.g. contractType/status strings are cast `as any` into Prisma enum columns at vendor.service.ts:107,130). Persistence works; input validation is absent.

F-WP-2 (no class-validator DTO + array body not validated): src/modules/project-registry/presentation/role-plan.controller.ts:37 — POST /projects/:id/role-plan binds @Body() entries: UpsertRolePlanEntryDto[] where UpsertRolePlanEntryDto is a bare interface (project-role-plan.service.ts:22) AND the body is an array passed without ParseArrayPipe. No per-item validation occurs; roleName etc. reach Prisma unchecked.

MINOR (actor not threaded — null audit, not a persistence failure): change-request.controller.ts:51-57 PATCH change-request calls service.update(crId, dto) without the principal, so updatedByPersonId is written null (service.update accepts an actorId param it never receives). Same shape: vendor.controller.ts create/update/assign/end never pass actorId, so createdByPersonId/updatedByPersonId on vendors + engagements are always null. projects.controller.ts createProject (line 93) likewise never passes actorId, leaving createdByPersonId unset on new projects despite CreateProjectService supporting it. Rows persist correctly; only the D-103 actor-audit columns are unpopulated.
evidence: Traced all 32 write endpoints controller->service->repo. PERSISTENCE: every handler persists via Prisma (projectRepository.save/Project.create, prisma.project.update, projectChangeRequest.create/update, projectRisk.create/update, projectMilestone.create/update/delete, projectRolePlan.create/update/delete, vendor.create/update + projectVendorEngagement.create/update, radiatorThresholdConfig.upsert, budgetApproval+projectBudget via prisma.$transaction in request/decide-budget-change.service). No stub/no-op service like the F-WP-3 cases bug found at the service layer. GUARDS: every write carries @RequireRoles with sane presets (PROJECT_DELIVERY_ROLES, EXEC_ROLES, BUDGET_ROLES/BUDGET_REQUEST_ROLES/BUDGET_DECIDE_ROLES, admin) verified against src/shared/auth/role-presets.ts; ParseUUIDPipe on all :id/:riskId/:crId/etc. params; reject paths require RequiredReasonBodyDto; budget decide enforces self-approval guard + PERSON-mode responsibility gating. ACTOR: budget (request/decide), risk (create/update/convert/resolve/close), milestone (create/update), role-plan (upsert/get), radiator-threshold (upsert), project lifecycle (submit/approve/reject/close/close-override), CR approve/reject, person cost-rate all correctly source actor from httpRequest.principal?.personId. DTO VALIDATION: change-request.dto, project-risk.dto, milestone.dto, threshold-upsert.dto, financial.dto (UpsertProjectBudgetDto/CreatePersonCostRateDto), request-budget-change.dto, update-vendor-engagement.request, create-project.request, assign-project-team.request are all proper class-validator classes. The two structural exceptions are flagged above (UpdateProjectRequestDto bare class; vendor + role-plan bare interfaces). Global ValidationPipe is whitelist:true WITHOUT forbidNonWhitelisted (src/main.ts:64-71), which is why the undecorated UpdateProjectRequestDto strips every field to a no-op PATCH rather than 400-rejecting.
